shots.why: THE BLOCK, live angle: Kuminga (white) rises for the step-back three, Wemby (#1 black) closes from the right and the ball has just left his hands and Wemby's hand meets it at about 0.04 s; the ball flies up and back (ESPN clip 50343302 'Victor Wembanyama throws down the hammer', Spurs vs Wolves Oct 31 2026; scorebug MIN 101 - 105 SAS, 4th 6:21)
Rewind: Kuminga brings it up and steps back on the left wing guarded by Fox (#4); scorebug MIN 101 - 105 SAS proves 'Spurs up four' (same ESPN clip)
The contact at half speed, closer: Wemby's hand on Kuminga's three (the key second, replayed once)
Wemby outruns everyone up the floor, takes Harper's pass and rises for the running dunk at the rim (live angle, 4th 6:19-6:17)
Overhead rim-cam replay of the same dunk: the ball goes through with Wemby on the rim = his 40th point (ESPN play-by-play 6:15, 101-107)

Close-up replay of a Wemby block on Beringer's drive in this game (ESPN clip 50342108 'elevates for the big-time block'; NOTE: that block was in the 1st quarter, not one of the two late ones, which have no clip; no scorebug in this angle)
Payoff: Wemby close-up, turns to show WEMBANYAMA 1 on his back (ESPN clip 50342995, same game; one camera shot 8.92-12.85 s, cropped above the scorebug, ends before the dissolve)
